replacements.De los engranajes al ordenador universal: From gears to the universal computer
replacements.Tres siglos de intentos por mecanizar el: Three centuries of attempts to mechanize thought. Each era solves a different problem: first the machine, then the theory, finally the union of both.
replacements.Máquinas que calculan, pero sin programa: Machines that calculate, but without a program
replacements.Qué puede computarse, y sus límites: What can be computed, and its limits
replacements.Pascal y Leibniz automatizan sumas y mul: Pascal and Leibniz automate addition and multiplication with gears. They calculate, but they cannot make decisions or change tasks.
replacements.Tarjetas perforadas controlan el patrón: Punched cards control the weaving pattern: the mechanism and the instructions are separated for the first time.
replacements.Hardware vs. instrucciones: la idea nace: Hardware vs. instructions: the idea begins here
replacements.Babbage diseña un ordenador general con: Babbage designs a general computer with arithmetic, memory, and branching. Lovelace writes the first published algorithm. Never built, but already complete on paper.
replacements.El razonamiento lógico se convierte en á: Logical reasoning becomes binary algebra: true/false, AND, OR, NOT. Shannon will use this decades later to design circuits.
replacements.Turing define qué significa computar con: Turing defines what it means to compute with a minimal abstract model. And proves that there are problems that no machine will ever be able to solve.
replacements.Qué es computable, y qué no puede serlo: What is computable, and what can never be computable
replacements.La información es una magnitud medible:: Information is a measurable quantity: bits, compression, reliable transmission. Communication has mathematical laws.
replacements.Datos e instrucciones comparten la misma: Data and instructions share the same memory. Changing programs no longer requires rewiring the machine.
replacements.McCarthy, Minsky y Shannon apuestan: la: McCarthy, Minsky, and Shannon make a bet: intelligence can be described with enough precision to simulate it in a machine. A hypothesis, not a proof, but the field begins.
replacements.Inicio formal del campo de la inteligenc: Formal beginning of the field of artificial intelligence
